writingIdeas.viewpoint: Stronger primary care is central to global health progress.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: Investment in accessible primary care prevents minor health problems from becoming expensive emergencies.
writingIdeas.argument: Hospitals are essential for complex treatment, but they are a costly first point of contact for common illness. A nearby primary-care team can vaccinate children, monitor blood pressure and identify dangerous symptoms before complications develop. In rural regions, combining community health workers with remote clinical support can extend this basic coverage without waiting for a specialist hospital in every town. Earlier care improves outcomes while reducing avoidable admissions. Health budgets should therefore protect routine local services alongside high-profile medical technology.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 加强初级医疗是推动全球健康进步的核心。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 投资便利的初级医疗可以防止小健康问题演变成昂贵的急症。

argumentSentences.text: Hospitals are essential for complex treatment, but they are a costly first point of contact for common illness.
argumentSentences.translation: 医院对复杂治疗必不可少，但把它作为常见疾病的首个接触点成本很高。

argumentSentences.text: A nearby primary-care team can vaccinate children, monitor blood pressure and identify dangerous symptoms before complications develop.
argumentSentences.translation: 附近的初级医疗团队可以为儿童接种疫苗、监测血压，并在并发症出现前识别危险症状。

argumentSentences.text: In rural regions, combining community health workers with remote clinical support can extend this basic coverage without waiting for a specialist hospital in every town.
argumentSentences.translation: 在乡村地区，把社区医护人员与远程临床支持结合起来，可以扩大基础覆盖，而无需等待每个城镇都建成专科医院。

argumentSentences.text: Earlier care improves outcomes while reducing avoidable admissions.
argumentSentences.translation: 更早提供医疗可以改善结果，同时减少可避免的住院。

argumentSentences.text: Health budgets should therefore protect routine local services alongside high-profile medical technology.
argumentSentences.translation: 因此，卫生预算应在高调医疗技术之外保护日常本地服务。

writingIdeas.viewpoint: International disease reporting should be supported, not merely demanded.
writingIdeas.topicSentence: Countries are more likely to report emerging outbreaks promptly when cooperation offers practical help rather than automatic punishment.
writingIdeas.argument: A government that expects immediate economic penalties may hesitate to announce an uncertain cluster of cases. That delay deprives neighbouring health systems of time to prepare and can ultimately allow wider transmission. International agreements should pair transparent reporting with rapid testing support, protective equipment and proportionate responses. Independent review can still address serious concealment, but routine uncertainty should not be treated as misconduct. Cooperation built around reciprocal assistance creates a stronger incentive for early warning than blame alone.
writingIdeas.viewpointTranslation: 国际疾病报告应得到支持，而不只是被要求履行。
writingIdeas.topicSentenceTranslation: 当合作提供实际帮助而非自动惩罚时，各国更可能及时报告新发疫情。

argumentSentences.text: A government that expects immediate economic penalties may hesitate to announce an uncertain cluster of cases.
argumentSentences.translation: 预期会立即遭受经济惩罚的政府，可能会犹豫是否公布尚不确定的病例聚集。

argumentSentences.text: That delay deprives neighbouring health systems of time to prepare and can ultimately allow wider transmission.
argumentSentences.translation: 这种延误会剥夺邻近卫生系统的准备时间，最终还可能造成更广泛传播。

argumentSentences.text: International agreements should pair transparent reporting with rapid testing support, protective equipment and proportionate responses.
argumentSentences.translation: 国际协议应把透明报告与快速检测支持、防护设备和适度应对结合起来。

argumentSentences.text: Independent review can still address serious concealment, but routine uncertainty should not be treated as misconduct.
argumentSentences.translation: 独立审查仍可处理严重隐瞒，但不应把日常的不确定性视为不当行为。

argumentSentences.text: Cooperation built around reciprocal assistance creates a stronger incentive for early warning than blame alone.
argumentSentences.translation: 以互助为基础的合作，比单纯指责更能激励早期预警。

speaking.question: Describe something you do to look after your health.
speaking.answer: One simple thing I do is take a brisk walk after dinner on most weekdays. I started because I was spending almost the whole day sitting at a desk, and a demanding exercise plan was difficult to maintain. The walk usually lasts about half an hour, and I choose a familiar route through a nearby residential area. It helps me separate work from the evening, and I often sleep better afterwards. I do not track every step or treat it as serious training, which is probably why the habit has lasted. If the weather is bad, I walk indoors or do some stretching instead. For me, looking after my health works best when the activity fits naturally into my routine.
speaking.questionTranslation: 请描述一件你为保持健康而做的事情。

answerSentences.text: One simple thing I do is take a brisk walk after dinner on most weekdays.
answerSentences.translation: 我做的一件简单事情，是大多数工作日晚饭后快走。

answerSentences.text: I started because I was spending almost the whole day sitting at a desk, and a demanding exercise plan was difficult to maintain.
answerSentences.translation: 我开始这样做，是因为我几乎整天坐在书桌前，而高强度锻炼计划很难坚持。

answerSentences.text: The walk usually lasts about half an hour, and I choose a familiar route through a nearby residential area.
answerSentences.translation: 散步通常持续约半小时，我会选择附近住宅区的一条熟悉路线。

answerSentences.text: It helps me separate work from the evening, and I often sleep better afterwards.
answerSentences.translation: 它帮助我把工作与夜晚分开，而且之后我常常睡得更好。

answerSentences.text: I do not track every step or treat it as serious training, which is probably why the habit has lasted.
answerSentences.translation: 我不会记录每一步，也不会把它当成严肃训练，这或许正是这个习惯得以保持的原因。

answerSentences.text: If the weather is bad, I walk indoors or do some stretching instead.
answerSentences.translation: 天气不好时，我会在室内走动或改做拉伸。

answerSentences.text: For me, looking after my health works best when the activity fits naturally into my routine.
answerSentences.translation: 对我而言，只有当活动自然融入日常安排时，保持健康才最有效。

speaking.question: Why do people sometimes avoid medical care even when they know they need it?
speaking.answer: Cost is an obvious reason in systems where patients pay directly, but time and uncertainty matter as well. Someone may be unable to leave work, arrange childcare or travel to a distant clinic. Others fear a diagnosis or hope that the problem will disappear, especially if the symptoms are embarrassing. Previous experiences of rushed or disrespectful care can also reduce trust. Services become easier to use when appointments are flexible, fees are clear and staff communicate without judgement. Public information should encourage early care, but it cannot substitute for removing these practical barriers.
speaking.questionTranslation: 为什么人们明知需要医疗帮助，有时仍会回避就医？

answerSentences.text: Cost is an obvious reason in systems where patients pay directly, but time and uncertainty matter as well.
answerSentences.translation: 在患者直接付费的医疗体系中，费用是明显原因，但时间和不确定性同样重要。

answerSentences.text: Someone may be unable to leave work, arrange childcare or travel to a distant clinic.
answerSentences.translation: 有人可能无法离开工作岗位、安排儿童照护或前往遥远诊所。

answerSentences.text: Others fear a diagnosis or hope that the problem will disappear, especially if the symptoms are embarrassing.
answerSentences.translation: 另一些人害怕诊断结果，或希望问题自行消失，尤其是症状令人难为情时。

answerSentences.text: Previous experiences of rushed or disrespectful care can also reduce trust.
answerSentences.translation: 过去遭遇仓促或不尊重的医疗，也会削弱信任。

answerSentences.text: Services become easier to use when appointments are flexible, fees are clear and staff communicate without judgement.
answerSentences.translation: 当预约灵活、收费清楚且工作人员交流时不加评判，服务会更容易使用。

answerSentences.text: Public information should encourage early care, but it cannot substitute for removing these practical barriers.
answerSentences.translation: 公共信息应鼓励尽早就医，但不能代替消除这些现实障碍。

reading.title: The Second Life of the Community Health Worker
paragraphs: During the 1970s, several countries trained local residents to deliver basic health education, support vaccination and recognise dangerous symptoms. These community health workers were expected to connect households with clinics that were too distant or understaffed to reach everyone. Some programmes achieved impressive results, but others faded when short-term funding ended, medicines became unavailable or volunteers were asked to perform expanding duties without adequate pay.

Interest returned in the early 2000s as governments sought to improve maternal care and respond to infectious diseases. The revived model differed from the earlier ideal of a broadly capable village volunteer. Many programmes assigned narrower tasks, supported by checklists and regular supervision: visiting newborns, observing tuberculosis treatment or testing for malaria. Mobile phones later made it possible to register patients, request advice and report stock shortages without travelling to a district office.

Technology did not remove the need for judgement. A digital form could indicate that a child required referral, yet the worker still had to explain the urgency, help the family arrange transport and alert a facility that might already be crowded. Researchers comparing programmes found that equipment alone predicted little. Reliable supplies, supportive supervision and a trusted relationship with the community were more consistently associated with good performance.

The question of employment has also become harder to avoid. Calling workers volunteers may keep a pilot inexpensive, but unpaid duties often fall on women who are already providing substantial care at home. High turnover then weakens local knowledge and wastes training. Several health systems have introduced salaries or defined career steps, although formalisation can create new paperwork and may recruit workers who live farther from the communities they serve.

Community health workers are neither substitutes for clinics nor temporary messengers. At their best, they form part of a connected system in which local trust, medical supplies, referral transport and professional care reinforce one another. Their history suggests that expanding a workforce is easier than sustaining the conditions that allow its members to do useful work.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Some programmes achieved impressive results, but others faded when short-term funding ended, medicines became unavailable or volunteers were asked to perform expanding duties without adequate pay.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Interest returned in the early 2000s as governments sought to improve maternal care and respond to infectious diseases.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The revived model differed from the earlier ideal of a broadly capable village volunteer.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Many programmes assigned narrower tasks, supported by checklists and regular supervision: visiting newborns, observing tuberculosis treatment or testing for malaria.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Mobile phones later made it possible to register patients, request advice and report stock shortages without travelling to a district office.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Technology did not remove the need for judgement.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: A digital form could indicate that a child required referral, yet the worker still had to explain the urgency, help the family arrange transport and alert a facility that might already be crowded.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 数字表格可以提示儿童需要转诊，但工作人员仍需说明紧迫性、帮助家庭安排交通，并通知可能已经拥挤的医疗机构。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Researchers comparing programmes found that equipment alone predicted little.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 比较不同项目的研究人员发现，单靠设备几乎不能预测成效。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Reliable supplies, supportive supervision and a trusted relationship with the community were more consistently associated with good performance.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 可靠物资、支持性督导以及与社区的信任关系，更稳定地与良好表现相关。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: The question of employment has also become harder to avoid.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Calling workers volunteers may keep a pilot inexpensive, but unpaid duties often fall on women who are already providing substantial care at home.
paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 把工作人员称为志愿者可以降低试点成本，但无偿职责往往落在已经在家承担大量照护工作的女性身上。

paragraphSentencePairs.text: High turnover then weakens local knowledge and wastes training.

paragraphSentencePairs.text: Several health systems have introduced salaries or defined career steps, although formalisation can create new paperwork and may recruit workers who live farther from the communities they serve.

paragraphSentencePairs.translation: 在最佳状态下，他们属于一个相互连接的体系，其中本地信任、医疗物资、转诊交通和专业照护彼此加强。
